_comment: Separate Minecraft accounts whose stats count as ONE player (an alt, or a new account).
Everything of 'from' is added into 'to': live stats and scoreboards, history (backup imports included),
firsts, milestones, badges and activity; looking 'from' up on the website shows 'to'.
Use uuids (names change). 'names' = the from-account's scoreboard names (scoreboards key by name).
Adding an entry: the next snapshot run backs up the DB and folds the existing data in, once.
Removing an entry does NOT split the data again: restore the pre-merge-*.db backup for that.
'renames': former names of ONE account (same uuid) that no usercache knows, so their scoreboard
scores (scoreboards key by name) count for that uuid. Optional 'from'/'until' (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC,
inclusive): when the name was this uuid's (for a name later used by someone else).
Adding a name: the next snapshot run folds its existing scoreboard history in, once.
Former names show on the player's page as 'aka' and are found by search.
